svg.title: Runtime revisions queried during native playback
svg.desc: Two MPEG2 sessions returned identical runtime GET_VERSION words 00013600, 00150323 and 00070015, with forty existing qualified MFD/SCL reads each. A six-session baseline, query, recovery, repeat, recovery and H264 control sequence delivered 1080 full-byte oracle-matched frames with firmware EOS and cleanup. Query is not passive MMIO; standalone raw processing remains unproved.

g.text: Runtime revision inventory in an owned native session
BCM70015 · MPEG-2 640×360 · default-off query · no extra firmware download or INIT
After OPEN, before START: one successful GET_VERSION in A and repeat
Runtime-reported opaque words, not compile-time constants · command/doorbell transaction, not passive MMIO
Complete native-control sequence — 180 frames, full-byte match, firmware EOS and cleanup each
Per query session: 1 query + 40 MFD/SCL READs across 2 stages; 8 inherited packing READs remain separate.
MFD REV 50 · SCL REV 80 · TEST4 · sampled SCL status 0 · no diagnostic target write or DATA-port read
6 × 180 = 1,080 native frames · FD 3→3 / threads 1→1 · RSS increased 1,440–1,524 KiB
Not a source/sink lease, transport/freshness certificate or standalone MFD/scaler/CSC/DNR result.
Raw records and scoped evidence: runtime-inventory.json · original issue92 remains incomplete
